name: Sophia
source:
Have you met Sophie?

Sophia, better known as Sophie and another popular cheerleader at the city college, is Chloe’s best friend. This raven-haired beauty, though mischievous and rather flirtatious, is actually quite good-natured. She seems friendly enough and could make things a little interesting.

She might help you out with other girls, but that doesn’t mean she can’t have fun in the meantime!
